author: Animalogic
description:
Cougars went extinct east of the Mississippi almost a hundred years ago. Or did they? Every year there are hundreds of reports and sightings of cougars all the way from the midwest to the east coast. So we're exploring those sightings, the science of cougar populations, and finding out where cougars actually live. They're closer to you than you think.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
